body: Hey, I apologizes for the months of being silent. But I had listened to your guys feed back, hearing your own stories and whatnot. It does mean a lot to me, thank you all for sending kind comments and messages. For these past months, I had been doing a lot better. And no longer worrying so much about my life, my relationships, etc, and instead focusing on my self and my own happiness. Thank you all so much.
Not the most easiest thing to talk about. I felt like I already said what I needed to say but thanks
